unit.why: A genealogical list of the tzaddik's surviving descendants and in-laws (daughters, their husbands, children, yahrzeit dates), with no narrative events; it closes with a section heading for the teachings that follow.
unit.boundary_note: Ends with a heading ('חידושים ומאמרים... ושיחות קדושים משמו') that introduces the sayings in the next divisions; previous division closed the death narrative.
